name: GrainMotion
description: An invented motion and surface system sold as plain CSS, with the page made of the thing it sells
intent: Two hundred and sixteen gradients on one page, and a demonstration that has to agree with the thing being demonstrated: the page is built out of the surface system it is selling, so a flaw in the product is a flaw in the page.
